name: Sprint 1 - Foundation
goal: Allow organizations to sign up, add leftover materials, check stock, and set up inspections.
outcome: All six committed stories and the bug were completed. Sprint 1 delivered 26 story points and fixed the reservation bug. Testing confirmed that unverified items are hidden from search and stock updates correctly.

name: Sprint 2 - Find Materials
goal: Help buyers find materials, check nearby listings, and submit material requests.
outcome: Sprint 2 is active. The team is building the path from finding materials to approving buyer requests. Deliveries, quantity mismatches, and impact reports are planned for Sprint 3.
